text:
vivian: Quick heads-up — partner PoC hit duplicate side-effects when using our Python async SDK with function/tool calling + structured outputs. They saw the send_email tool invoked twice for a single user prompt.

vivian: Repro (trimmed):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
import os, uuid, asyncio

client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

async def run():
    invocation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    resp = await client.chat.create(
        model='rwd-1-3b',
        messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Send welcome email to user@example.com'}],
        tools=[{
            'name':'send_email',
            'parameters': {'to':'string','subject':'string','body':'string'},
            'metadata': {'invocation_id': invocation_id},
            'returns': 'application/json'
        }],
        function_call='auto'
    )
    print('chat id', resp.id)

asyncio.run(run())
```

vivian: Network trace shows two POSTs with different request ids but identical tool.metadata.invocation_id. Server emitted two function_invoke events.

noah: Any 401s or 5xx that would trigger a retry?

vivian: No 401s. Partner reported a response stream timeout; client retried the high-level request which had already triggered the tool server-side.

kevin: Classic at-least-once delivery. Two mitigation paths: (1) Server-side dedupe keyed by an invocation id/header, (2) Client-side conservative retry behavior once a tool decision is observed. We should do both.

anya: Short-term we can teach sample apps to generate invocation_id and include it in tool metadata. SDK can forward that as x-invocation-id header if present. Also add a README note recommending disabling automatic retries for side-effecting tool calls.

noah: Longer-term, eng-runtime should accept x-invocation-id and dedupe invocations across retries. I'll file infra ticket.

kevin: Also change SDK default: when a response indicates function_call, suppress automatic retries for that user message unless the caller sets allow_tool_call_retries=True. Add telemetry/logging so suppressed retries are visible.

anya: Tests: unit test asserting header sent when tool.metadata.invocation_id exists, and an integration test simulating a stream timeout where the SDK does not retry the tool call.

ops-bot: created ticket 11022 (sdk: toolcall idempotency + retry policy) and pinged eng-runtime.

vivian: I'll open a small PR with a sample-app patch and the mitigation guide for partners. Will include recommended SDK flag and example for structured returns (returns='application/json') with a tiny JSON schema example.

noah: Thanks — priority for current sprint.

vivian: Will post PR link here when ready.
